Energy price cap from 1 October to 31 December 2026

From 1 October to 31 December 2026, the price cap will be £1,723 per year. This has gone up by 4% compared to the last price cap period.

This figure is based on the average energy unit rate and standing charge for people who pay by Direct Debit in England, Scotland and Wales.
